network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ricostruisce la piena del Po e pubblica colmi nelle sezioni principali più a valle, ma non una misura a Sanfront. Il valore di Villafranca non viene retrotrasferito all'alto Po presso il ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The report reconstructs the Po flood and publishes peaks at principal stations farther downstream but no Sanfront measurement. The Villafranca value is not back-transferred to the upper Po bridge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
